purpose: Before new fitting, count single-frame identity-correction opportunities in primary and secondary assignments, including a previously unmatched track or detection. Observe an unchanged original teacher, not an oracle tracker.
setting: Fixed November DiffV2IR/ProtocolV2 and original RGB-only YOLOX-X+ByteTrack Test29.528970687393972. Minimum34.52897068739397, stretch39.52897068739397. No strongestRGB/crossarchitecture sweep.
prior_boundary: The previous primary-only closed2cycle/3frame-margin study found late beneficial windows but no accepted beneficial window; its tracker plan was not executed. The present census adds unmatched-endpoint actions, all three original assignment stages, single-frame features, and explicit50/25/25 time partitions. It is not a repeat of a validated positive result.
geometric_admission: Every proposed edge passes the original stage threshold: primary0.9, secondary0.5, pending0.7. Both original and proposed real tracks need at least3 reliable observations, RGB template and a valid locked first3 RGB anchor. Every action keeps assignment cardinality; open actions may change the matched row or column set.
teacher: Original ByteTrack25-frame buffer and current-measured-shape rendering, with original scores/partitions/births/updates and no learned association correction. Extra first3 anchors and causal per-modality descriptor-variation statistics do not feed back into that teacher.
feature_rules: 41 scalar current/past features: before/after/minimum relative RGB/IR and locked-anchor similarities, geometry, current/past quality, history ages, separate RGB/IR descriptor variation, anchor/EMA agreement, action/stage flags. No GT ID, absolute frame, video name, label or future view belongs to a feature.
label_stage: All6 GT-free producers must actually exit0 before a separate Train-only worker labels actions. Past identity uses >=3 known observations and >=0.8 purity, committed after each current frame. Current labels retain HungarianIoU0.5/background0.2/ignored rules. Unknown actions stay in source and receive no supervised target.
target: Known action delta equals correct predicted-identity/detection pairs after minus before; this is a local identity proxy, not HOTA or an online oracle.
later_fit_if_qualified: Only after this evidence review: matched41D RGB-mask, paired, duplicatedRGB small heads, identical seed0/parameter budget, first50 fitting/middle25 calibration/last25 diagnostic. At most GPUs4/5, no new seed or encoder/image cache. This census does not implement or claim those fitted heads.
exposure: Historical Test and earlier Train development windows were exposed. Old encoders saw Train identities; older detector saw Dev. This is not a fresh blind or unseen-identity test.
